requirements.description: Every train, heldout, counterfactual, and ablation context must be explicitly identified and audited for leakage.
Heldout split must contain unseen partner dynamics or update rules, not only renamed labels or hidden answers.
At least one family must shift partner policy after interaction history so other-state updates are required.
Counterfactual probes must alter partner response structure while controlling non-causal surfaces where possible.
Counterfactual evaluation must include interventions on candidate social-latent state or update path.
Counterfactual evaluation must intervene on the partner-observation stream or history and check predicted changes.
At least one context must deliberately inject leakage and must be detected by scanners.
At least one context must remove social signal and block false positive success.

blocking_conditions: heldout context IDs encode target or partner type
heldout split contains only label renaming
